business_days: Business days are Monday to Friday, except 2026-10-16, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-26 and 2027-01-01.
deadline: The deadline is a count of calendar days after today.
Saturday, Sunday and holidays do count in the count.
| 1 to 10 | the 5th calendar day, Monday 19 October 2026 | Monday 19 October 2026 | 1 |
| 11 to 45 | the 4th calendar day, Sunday 18 October 2026 | Thursday 15 October 2026 | 2 |
The latest business day on or before Sunday 18 October is Thursday 15 October 2026.
earliest: First ask: "Can you pay the full balance today?"
on_non_business_day: A weekend or a holiday that is not after the deadline moves to the next business day, if that day is not after the latest recordable day.
on_after_deadline: A date after the latest recordable day: say that day is the latest and offer the full balance on it.
A refusal is a flat refusal.
identity: Ask the date of birth, then the last four digits of the phone number.
Three wrong answers: `not_verified` / `failed`, and do not state the account.
products: Name the product, the past-due amount and the days late.
A partial payment is accepted only when it is exactly 50 percent of `past_due`, rounded half up to the penny.
amounts: Ask for the full past-due amount.
Never ask how much they can pay.
The offer does not use an attempt.
`minimum_payment` and `instalment_amount` are not a partial payment.
writes: A second failure closes `no_promise` / `service_error` and does not say that sentence.
Book the callback when it is today or the next business day, from 09:00 to 17:00, both included, and later than `now`.
attempts.plan.early: Attempt 1 is the full balance on the latest recordable day.
attempts.plan.late: Attempt 1 is the full balance on the latest recordable day.
Attempt 2, late band only, is the 50 percent figure on that day.

stable: Do not say collections, debt, payment or a product before identity is verified.
Do not discuss the account before 08:00 or after 18:00.
dropped_unstable: A promise must still fall on a business day.
A refusal is a flat refusal.
If `now` were outside it, do not verify and do not state the account: offer a callback for the next business day at 09:00, schedule it, and close `not_reached` / `callback`.
`minimum_payment` and `instalment_amount` are not a partial payment.
Never ask how much they can pay.
The kit outcome list has no complaint value.
The latest business day on or before Sunday 18 October is Thursday 15 October 2026.
The note question in rule 14 is not used after a recorded promise, and it is not used for `service_error`.
